title: Element owners
description: The accountable owner a venture names for an element of APQC's Process Classification Framework (EE-187): a category, process group, process, activity or task in packages/naive/src/functions/pcf.json. An element with no entry takes its parent's owner, and a category with none is owned by its function's agent. The owner is accountable, the one who answers for the element; who performs an activity is in operations/activity-assignments.json. The file is operations/element-owners.json, and packages/naive/src/engine/element-owners.ts resolves it.

owners.description: Per element, by its APQC hierarchy id (3.0 for a category, 3.5 for a process group, 3.5.1.6 for an activity): the role or the person accountable for it

role.description: A role id: a role template in packages/naive/template/governance/roles/ or the venture's governance/roles/, or a function agent, <function>-agent. A role whose template has default_tier person is a person; the rest are agents

person.description: A person by name, when the accountable owner is a named person rather than a role
